notes: Independently composed native SVG color fields with baked static shadows, not generated bitmap art. No exports resized.

Three large fields: purple upper background, pink lower background, yellow only for the floor. Broad asymmetric scallops with long shelves and rounded returning curves inspired by the annotated reference.

Static cast shadows use upper-right screen-space light: offset -12,+16 pixels, Gaussian sigma 3 pixels, black opacity 0.24. The game source darkens receiver colors and default light is vec3(-.45,.8,.5); this is visual consistency, not a simulation of each gameplay camera.
No character, source lettering, interface, floor grid, renderer horizon or piece shadows included.
